title: ATM 吞卡、取不出钱，怎么办？
summary: 取款机吞卡或故障：记下机器编号，打银行客服，申请补卡或退钱。

phrases.en: The ATM didn't give me my cash.
Can you send me a new card?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, the ATM ate my card just now.
dialogue.zh: 你好，取款机刚才把我的卡吞了。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: I'm sorry. Do you know the ATM location or number?
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，知道那台机器的位置或编号吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: It's the one outside the Main Street branch.
dialogue.zh: 就是 Main Street 网点门口那台。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Got it. I've frozen your card. Can you come to the branch tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 记下了，卡已冻结，明天能来网点一趟吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes. Can I get my card back there?
dialogue.zh: 可以，能在网点拿回我的卡吗？

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: We'll check. If not, we'll send you a new one.
dialogue.zh: 我们查一下，拿不回来就给你寄张新的。

seoTitle: 美国 ATM 吞卡英语怎么说？取款机故障对话
seoDescription: ATM 吞卡、取不出钱：打银行客服的完整英语说法，附真实对话，冷静处理。
